newsitem.title: INDIA: India Congress chief asks ex-PM Rao to resign.
newsitem.headline: India Congress chief asks ex-PM Rao to resign.

text.p: The chief of India's Congress party on Wednesday asked former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao to step down from his influential post as leader of the party's parliamentary bloc, the United News of India (UNI) reported.
"Congress president Sitaram Kesri asks P.V. Narasimha Rao to step down from Congress Parliamentary Party (CPP) leadership," the UNI said.
Twenty-one members of the CPP's executive committee and three office bearers had asked Rao to step down as the head of the parliamentary bloc on Wednesday morning.
The Congress Working Committee (CWC), the party's elite decision making body, later at a meeting delegated Kesri to talk to Rao and persuade him to step down as the leader of the CPP.

Rao, who led Congress to its worst defeat in general elections earlier this year, resigned as party president in September after a court summoned him to testify in a criminal conspiracy case. He denied any wrongdoing.
